Part (d)
• A majority of the responses recognized the need to use integration by parts and most of these made appropriate
choices for u and dv. A significant number of responses used a tabular approach to integration by parts.
• Most responses had no trouble integrating t + 5, although necessary parentheses were occasionally omitted.
